objective: Test whether frozen e33 can route specialists when the mastered cognitive action and the registry expert identity are requested as two separate one-field typed decisions.

causal_basis.finding: The joint two-field action-plus-expert schema degraded typed transport and never connected source or recursive-manager expert selection.
causal_basis.hypothesis: A tight split interface reduces the 2B decision to two stable one-field classifications without moving weights.

stage_two.condition: run only for prompts whose public facts make delegate_terminal the legal action

decision_rule.if_pass: Implement the same two-stage decision in the live tight scaffold and run a separate no-update end-to-end screen before specialist training.
decision_rule.if_expert_stage_fails: Keep e33 canonical and preregister expert-only SFT; do not retrain the mastered cognitive action.
decision_rule.if_action_stage_fails: Reject the probe context as inconsistent with the protected adaptive contract before changing weights.
